messages.subject: [Rnomads-user] FW: [NCEP.list.NOMADS-ftpprd] Pending Upgrades & Announcements 06/04/19
messages.body_plain:
Hello guys,

Just a heads up, I have received this mail from GFS. It seems to me this change would break rNOMADS.
The new grib filter seems up already, so we can start testing on this new environment.

Felipe B Boralli

From: ncep.list.nomads-ftpprd-bounces at lstsrv.ncep.noaa.gov [mailto:ncep.list.nomads-ftpprd-bounces at lstsrv.ncep.noaa.gov] On Behalf Of NOMADS-FTPPRD list
Sent: terÃ§a-feira, 4 de junho de 2019 14:03
To: _NCEP list.nomads-ftpprd <ncep.list.nomads-ftpprd at noaa.gov>
Subject: [SPAM:BULK-MAIL] [NCEP.list.NOMADS-ftpprd] Pending Upgrades & Announcements 06/04/19

Summary
* GFS will have a major upgrade with the 12z cycle June 12. Starting with the 12z cycle June 12, GFS data will move to the new directory structure of gfs.YYYYMMDD/CC/ from gfs.YYYYMMDDCC/. Data will not be backfilled.
* Grib filter for the parallel GFSv15 0.25 deg output is now on nomads.ncep.noaa.gov<http://nomads.ncep.noaa.gov>, listed at the bottom of the page. The script name is different to keep separate from current production, and will move back to the production names June 12.

Please see below for changes and upgrades:

GFS Version 15.1 (FV3) Upgrade
  Scheduled Implementation Date: June 12, 2019
  Parallel data:
 https://para.nomads.ncep.noaa.gov
  NEW Parallel version of grib filter:
https://nomads.ncep.noaa.gov/cgi-bin/filter_fv3_gfs_0p25.pl
https://nomads.ncep.noaa.gov/cgi-bin/filter_fv3_gfs_0p25_1hr.pl
  Documentation: https://www.emc.ncep.noaa.gov/users/meg/fv3gfs/
  SCN: https://www.weather.gov/media/notification/scn19-40gfs_v15_1.pdf

HYSPLIT Upgrade
  Scheduled Implementation Date: June 12, 2019
  Parallel data:
 https://para.nomads.ncep.noaa.gov
  SCN: https://www.weather.gov/media/notification/scn19-38hysplit_upgrade.pdf

NAM and HiRes Changes
  Scheduled Implementation Date: June 12, 2019
  Parallel data:
 https://para.nomads.ncep.noaa.gov
  SCN: https://www.weather.gov/media/notification/scn19-41nam_hiresw.pdf

Marine Fog Product Replacement
  Scheduled Implementation Date: June 12, 2019
  SCN: https://www.weather.gov/media/notification/scn19-39marine_fog_replacement.pdf

National Water Model Version 2.0 Upgrade
  Scheduled Implementation Date: June 19, 2019
  Parallel Data:
http://para.nomads.ncep.noaa.gov<http://para.nomads.ncep.noaa.gov/>
  SCN: https://www.weather.gov/media/notification/scn19-42natl_water_model.pdf

--
Anne Myckow
Lead Dataflow Analyst
NOAA/NCEP/NCO
